card_a.text: [A busy single mother] I work late hours every day to sustain my family. I worry because my children stay alone at home without hot dinners.

card_a.text: [A frustrated environmentalist] The beautiful local beach is ruined by plastic waste from the ocean. This pollution harms marine life and smells terrible.

card_a.text: [A school librarian] Our elementary school library has plenty of great books. However, we need someone to read stories to children to encourage reading habits.

[A non-Japanese resident] A major flood warning was issued in my town. However, all emergency announcements are in fast Japanese, so I am terrified.
[A bedridden patient] I cannot leave my bed due to a serious illness. I struggle to cook healthy meals, and I often skip eating.
[A parent of young children] The neighborhood park is covered in tall weeds and sharp glass. It is too dangerous for children to play there safely.
[A low-income student] I want to study hard for high school entrance exams. However, my parents cannot afford expensive private cram schools.

vocabulary.meaning: （経済的・社会的に）恵まれない

card_a.text: [A traditional craftsman] The unique cultural technique of making local pottery is dying out. Young people do not know about our historical heritage.

[A wheelchair user] The paths near the train station are blocked by illegally parked bicycles. I am forced to roll onto the dangerous car road.
[A worried daughter] My mother has dementia and sometimes gets lost outside. I am afraid she might have an accident when I am working.
[A historical site manager] Many foreign tourists visit our ancient local shrine. However, there are no English signs, so they miss its historical value.
[A high school student] I want to start volunteering to help society, but I do not know where to look. I am afraid of joining an untrustworthy group.

vocabulary.meaning: コーディネーター、調整担当者

card_a.text: [A visually impaired person] I want to read the city’s monthly news magazine. However, there is no audio version, so I cannot get important local updates.

card_a.text: [A deaf citizen] I need to visit the city hall to apply for welfare support. I am worried because the staff there do not understand sign language.

card_a.text: Those two spotted cats look exactly the same to me. How can you tell them apart?

card_a.text: It's too dark to take a good picture of the owls. I'm going to turn on my camera flash.

怯えさせる、怖がらせる

card_a.text: I've been looking at the tiger enclosure for ten minutes, but it's completely empty.
Can my children feed the goats and sheep? They brought some carrots from home.
Why are there only a few Sumatran rhinos left in the world? What happened to them?
An elephant's trunk is so long and flexible. What do they mainly use it for besides drinking?
The bears seem very inactive today. Are they sick or just tired?

vocabulary.meaning: 不活発な、活動していない

card_a.text: Are these baby pandas going to stay in this zoo forever, or will they go back to the wild?
I can't see the stick insect in this exhibit. It just looks like a bunch of dead branches.
My toddler is too tired to walk the entire zoo. Do you have any strollers available for rent?
How do these migratory birds know exactly where to fly thousands of miles every single year?

vocabulary.meaning: 航行する、進路を見つける

card_a.text: Why do the iguanas and snakes spend so much time just lying motionless on those hot rocks?
We've seen all the animals and want to buy some stuffed toys before we leave. Where is the gift shop?
That chimpanzee is using a stick to get food out of a hole. I didn't know they could use tools!
The lion looks like it's limping. Is there anyone taking care of its injured leg?
Look at the baby kangaroo! It just jumped headfirst back into its mother's stomach.

vocabulary.meaning: 真っ逆さまに、頭から先に

card_a.text: It's a bit scary seeing the tigers eating raw chunks of meat with bones still attached.

This bald eagle has a broken wing. Will it have to stay in this enclosure for the rest of its life?

vocabulary.meaning: 社会（野生）復帰させる、リハビリする

card_a.text: Why are they hiding food inside cardboard boxes and freezing fruit in blocks of ice for the bears?

I love the red pandas so much. Is there any way I can financially support their care and conservation?
The sign says orangutans might disappear in 20 years. Why are their numbers dropping so fast?

vocabulary.meaning: 大農園、プランテーション

card_a.text: As soon as I walked into the tropical bird exhibit, my glasses fogged up completely.

card_a.text: Feeding the animals looks like a fun job. Is that all the zookeepers do all day?
